meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 迁移 OpenClaw 的配置与任务到 NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想从 OpenClaw 换到 NanoClaw,又不想丢失现有配置。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate your OpenClaw setup to NanoClaw v2 while keeping your data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are moving from OpenClaw to NanoClaw and want to keep your existing setup.

howto.what: 它会扫描你已有的 OpenClaw 安装，把身份、频道凭证、定时任务等配置逐项和你讨论确认后，迁移进 NanoClaw v2，写入前先给你看改动方案。
howto.when: 当你提到「migrate from openclaw」、「openclaw migration」等关键词，或要求从 OpenClaw 导入时触发。

say.text: 帮我从 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2
say.note: 它会先扫描并汇总检测到的安装。

say.text: 我的 OpenClaw 装在自定义路径，用这个目录迁移
say.note: 该路径会作为 --state-dir 传入。

say.text: OpenClaw 里的定时任务也一起迁过来
say.note: 它会读取 cron 任务并逐项映射。

howto.what_en: It scans your existing OpenClaw install and walks you through migrating identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks and other config into NanoClaw v2, showing proposed changes before applying.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration" or "import from openclaw", or otherwise ask to import from OpenClaw.

say_en.text: Migrate me from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2
say_en.note: It first scans and summarizes the install.

say_en.text: My OpenClaw lives at a custom path, use that directory
Bring my OpenClaw scheduled tasks over too
say_en.note: It reads cron jobs and maps each one.
